mapper.select: SELECT item.id, item.order_id AS orderId, item.sku_id AS skuId, sku.product_id AS productId, item.product_name AS productName, item.sku_spec AS skuSpec, item.quantity, item.unit_price AS unitPrice FROM order_items item JOIN skus sku ON sku.id = item.sku_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY item.id
